frontProfileSilhouette.label: front/profile silhouette
frontProfileSilhouette.note: Head taper, strand-grouped crown, high ponytail, deltoid-capped shoulders, athletic torso and cuffed legs follow the locked front/profile hierarchy.

headBodyProportions.label: head/body proportions
headBodyProportions.note: Head is width~height with held cheek width through the jawbone, a sculpted chin that breaks the profile, and a tapered neck — the four-head child proportion with real facial structure, not an egg.

hairMass.label: hair mass
hairMass.note: Full crown with warm-sheen strand ridges, hairline tucked under the headband, a gather knot, and two-tone grooved strand grouping down the swept ponytail.

clothingConstruction.label: clothing construction
clothingConstruction.note: Signature crimson kit in the authored palette, corrected sleeve cuffs and layered sneakers with readable soles, toe caps, laces and sidewall definition; the headband ring is now twist-free.

faceExpressionRead.label: face/expression read
faceExpressionRead.note: Eyes with sclera, iris, pupil and lash-weighted lids; tapered concept-weight brows; a sculpted nose that owns the feature (no drawn double); a tapered neck column; constructed ears with rim, concha and lobe. The face reads as a form, not a sticker.
